summary.name: ERIUS PHONE
summary.one_liner: ERIUS PHONE is hosted virtual Android phones that AI agents can control over an HTTP API or an open-source MCP server, currently in early access.
use_cases: let an AI agent operate a real Android app
test mobile apps on hosted Android devices
install APKs and pull crash logs remotely
automate tasks on a persistent cloud phone
run isolated device sessions for agents
summary.what_it_does: ERIUS PHONE provides hosted Android phones that an AI agent can control through an HTTP API or an open-source MCP server. Per the listing, an agent can read the screen, tap, type, swipe, install APKs and pull crash logs. The page describes the Android system as a full OS with normal permissions, notifications, keyboards and back stack. Each phone is described as carrying a Samsung S25-class device profile (model, brand, manufacturer), with the underlying system listed as Android 13 and the phone profile as Android 15 / Galaxy S25. The page also describes the phones as isolated and persistent.
notable: Agents control real Android OS via HTTP API or MCP server
Samsung S25-class device profile instead of generic emulator defaults
Screen reading via accessibility tree, plus APK install and crash log retrieval
caveats: Listing tags it as paid, but the page itself does not state pricing
Underlying system is Android 13 while the phone profile reports Android 15 / Galaxy S25
